concept.title: Telephone helpline support
concept.shortdesc: Getting information, advice, emotional support or counselling by speaking to someone on a telephone helpline or phone call.

keywords.keyword: speak to an adviser on the phone

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: helpline combined with email or live chat
text or online messaging with a supporter: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (written chat rather than voice call)
general support: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (no phone or helpline element)
having someone to talk to: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (informal listening not tied to a phone line)
